name: Office Crush Dating Simulator
storyline:
After moving to the city with your best friend, you finally land an internship as an Event Designer at Pixel Playground Studios. To your surprise, your workplace is filled with attractive and eligible bachelors, each with their own charm and compelling backstories.

Will you fall for the strong and dependable Event Manager, the shy Graphic Designer, the playboy Social Media Strategist, the cunning Creative Director, or the quiet Exhibition Coordinator?

As you navigate your internship and budding office romances, an unsettling feeling creeps in — strange occurrences, unexplained disappearances, and an eerie presence that shouldn’t be there. Is it all just a coincidence, or is something more sinister lurking beneath the surface? Your choices will shape your fate — both in love and survival.
summary: A dating simulator where you romance your handsome co-workers and nothing goes wrong.
